answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. Every claim climbs the nectar of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ferrous re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the nebula is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
